verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no compatibility layer, command aliases, or interface mode that mirrors an incumbent package manager such as MacPorts, apt or Nix. The Brewfile is only described by analogy to package.json/Gemfile, and user-editable aliases are a user-side workaround, not a migration feature. Community comments about MacPorts and Nix switchers praise Homebrew's simplicity rather than any familiar-command support.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can keep using familiar commands and interface conventions from the incumbent tool while adopting this manager
